next_label_hue.description:
The colour a new label gets when none is given: the first palette
colour no label uses yet, else the least-used one.

old_keys.description: Keys it had before; they still find it.

open_tasks.description: Open tasks in this project alone.

parent.description: The parent's key; left out for a top-level project.

path.description:
The names from the top-level project down to this one, joined by
" / ".

total_tasks.description: All tasks in this project alone, open or closed (not in the trash).

ProjectIcon.description:
An icon that stands for a project instead of its coloured circle, drawn
in the project's colour. The names are those of the app's icon family
(Lucide), so each variant's name says what it shows.

ProjectState.description: Whether a project can be changed.

oneOf.description: Read-only and hidden from the sidebar until unarchived.

RuleSet.description: One field a status sets when a task enters it.

field.description:
The field: `start_date`, `due_date`, `progress`, `priority`, or a
custom field as `cf:<id>`.

only_if_empty.description:
Only when the field has no value yet (a start date already set is
kept).

value.description:
The value as text: `today` for a date, 0 to 100 for progress, a
priority's name (`high`), or a custom field's value as it is
written (`today` for a date field, one option of a select field).

category.description: What it means for the work in it.

rules.description: Its rules for tasks entering it; left out when it has none.

wip_limit.description: Most tasks the column should hold; left out when there is no limit.

wip_min.description:
Fewest tasks the column should hold; left out when there is no
minimum.

StatusRules.description: The rules of one status. Everything left out is no rule.

agents_may_not_enter.description:
Agents may not move tasks into the status, nor create tasks in it
(for example Done, so that a person reviews first).

clear.description:
Fields cleared when a task enters the status: `start_date`,
`due_date`, `estimate`, `progress`, `fix_version`, or a custom field
that isn't required.

read_only.description:
Fields that can't change while a task is in the status: `title`,
`description`, `type`, `priority`, `start_date`, `due_date`,
`estimate`, `progress`, `labels`, `parent`, `fix_version`, or a
custom field.

release_claim.description: Release an agent's claim when the task enters the status.

required.description:
Fields that must have a value before a task enters the status:
`description`, `priority`, `start_date`, `due_date`, `estimate`,
`labels`, `parent`, `fix_version`, or a custom field.

set.description: Fields set when a task enters the status.

stop_timer.description: Stop the timer when its task enters the status; the time is logged.

due_offset_days.description:
New tasks of this type are due this many days after the day they
are made, unless given a due date; left out when they get none.

is_default.description: Whether new tasks get it unless told otherwise.

output.description: A project changed, with the history group of the change.

group.description:
The history group, for revert and Undo; left out when nothing
changed.

project.description: The project after the change.

views_rewritten.description:
The saved views whose queries were rewritten because a status, type,
label or the project key they name was renamed, or a label they name
was deleted, by name; left out when none was.

output.title: ProjectChange

operations.summary: Change a project's status rules (fields set, cleared or required when a task enters a status, fields read-only in it, the timer and claims) and its rules for agents (statuses they may not move tasks into, fields they may not change).

project.description:
The project (key or ID): its rules and the workspace's; left out:
every rule.

oneOf.description: Set task fields: `fields` maps a field to its value.

Create a subtask titled `text`, from task template `template` when
one is named.

Create a task titled `text` in the same project, from task template
`template` when one is named, linked to the task by `link`.

Leave a notification with `text`; the app shows it with the
reminders.

ActorKind.description: A person, an agent, or an automation rule acting on its own.

oneOf.description: The person who owns the workspace.
An automation rule of the workspace; the actor's name is the rule's.

AutomationAction.description:
One thing a rule does. Texts may hold placeholders: `{key}`,
`{title}`, `{status}`, `{priority}`, `{due_date}`, `{project}`,
`{rule}`, `{actor}` (who made the change that set the rule off) and
`{today}`.

fields.description:
`set_fields`: field to value. `title`, `description`, `type`,
`priority`, `start_date` and `due_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, `today`,
`+3d`, `next mon`), `estimate` (`2h`), `progress` (0 to 100),
`fix_version`, or a custom field by name, query name or ID; `null`
clears a field.

link.description:
`create_linked_task`: how the link reads from the task the rule
acts on; default `relates`.

template.description:
`create_subtask`, `create_linked_task`: a task template of the
project, by name.

text.description:
`add_comment`, `notify`: the text; `create_subtask`,
`create_linked_task`: the new task's title (default the template's).

condition.description: A query (TQL) the task must match; empty: every task.

held_as_agent.description:
Whether an agent made or last changed it: its runs are then held to
the rules for agents.

name.description:
Its name, unique in its project (or among the workspace's rules); it
names the rule in history.

project.description: The project, by key; left out for a rule of the whole workspace.

runs.description: Its last runs, newest first; only `automation.get` fills it in.

AutomationRun.description: One run of a rule, from its log.

at.description: When it ran (RFC 3339, UTC).

depth.description:
How many rules came before it in the chain (0: set off by a change
of a person, an agent or the schedule).

error.description: Why it failed or was limited.

group.description: The history group of its changes, when it made some.

rule_name.description: The rule's name when it ran.

task.description: The task it acted on, by key; left out when it no longer exists.

AutomationTrigger.description:
What sets a rule off, with what the kind needs. The same type is read
and written, so its optional fields are left out rather than `null`.

fields.description:
`field_changed`: the fields to watch (`status`, `priority`,
`labels`, `due_date`, …, or a custom field as `cf:<id>`); none: any.

status.description: `moved_to_status`: the status, by name; none: any status.

time.description: `schedule`: the time of day, `HH:MM`, in the workspace's time zone.

weekday.description: `schedule` with `every: weekly`: the day of the week.

ErrorCode.description:
What kind of failure an operation error is. Adapters decide on the code, never
on the message.

oneOf.description:
The input doesn't parse or breaks a rule; `details.path` names the
field when there is one.

No such item or name; `details.choices` lists the valid ones when the
list is short.

The item changed since the caller read it, or the change collides
with a newer one.

The caller's profile doesn't allow this, the operation needs a
confirmation that wasn't given, or the item is archived.
A size limit, a cap on bulk changes or a rate limit.
Another program kept the workspace locked; trying again later works.

A newer program upgraded the workspace while this one was running.
The program must restart.
The workspace was made by a newer program.
The disk, the file system or the database failed.

OpError.description:
An operation failed. The message says what happened, the hint what to do
next; both are written for the reader, person or agent.

details.description:
Facts a program can act on: `path`, `choices`, `current_version`,
`max`, `retry_after`, …

column.description:
The column's name in the header row, ignoring case. Every column with this
name goes to the same place; their values are taken together (Jira
writes one `Labels` column per label).

`labels`, `fix_version` (an open version of the project, by name),
`start_date`, `due_date`, `estimate`, `spent` (time
logged on the import day), `comment`, `key` (the row's key or ID in
the other tool, for references), `parent` (a key or ID, of a row of
the file or a task here), `blocks`, `blocked_by`, `relates`,
`duplicates`, `duplicated_by`, `clones`, `cloned_by`, `relations`
(Redmine's "Blocks #12, Related to #13"), `field.<name>` for a custom
field, or `ignore`.
